summaryZh: 2026年Husker Harvest Days将于9月15-17日举行，首次与美国全国牧牛人牛肉协会合作，引入牲畜管理培训项目。展会设有牛肉建筑内的每日培训课程，由专家Kurt Pate和Ron Gill指导低应激牛只处理、设施设计和牛肉质量保证协议。同时，展会继续展示大田作物现场演示，新增玉米秸秆打捆、粉碎机和饲料搅拌机演示，以及扩展的无人机区。近600家参展商将参展，吸引来自20多个州的农业生产者。

Husker Harvest Days 2026 to spotlight beef industry training

Farm Progress America: Nebraska's premier farm show expands livestock programming with National Cattlemen's Beef Association partnership for hands-on cattle handling education.

July 24, 2026

Husker Harvest Days is doubling down on its livestock roots this September, bringing the National Cattlemen's Beef Association's stockmanship program to the show for the first time.

The three-day event, running September 15-17, will feature daily training sessions in the beef building led by industry experts Kurt Pate and Ron Gill. Pate, a recognized clinician in stockmanship and safety, and Gill, a Texas AgriLife Extension specialist, will provide hands-on instruction in low-stress cattle handling, facility design, and beef quality assurance protocols.

"Husker Harvest Days bills itself as the world's largest totally irrigated working farm show," according to the show's promotional materials, emphasizing its unique position serving both crop and livestock producers across the Western Corn Belt.

The show continues to deliver for row crop farmers with live field demonstrations across a dozen categories. New for 2026 are demonstrations of corn stalk baling, tub grinders, and feed mixers, plus an expanded drone zone for precision agriculture enthusiasts.

Related:EPA manure emissions reporting exemption faces legal challenge

Nearly 600 exhibitors will set up on the working farm site near Grand Island, drawing producers from more than two dozen states. The show's real-world conditions—equipment running in actual field settings rather than parking lots—have made it a must-attend event since its founding by Nebraska Farmer magazine in 1978.

Whether you run cattle, grow crops, or do both, the show offers practical insights into where agriculture is headed. Details are available at huskerharvestdays.com.

translationZh:
Husker Harvest Days今年九月将加倍投入其畜牧根基，首次将美国全国牧牛人牛肉协会的牲畜管理项目引入展会。

这场为期三天的活动将于9月15日至17日举行，每天在牛肉建筑内举办由行业专家Kurt Pate和Ron Gill主导的培训课程。Pate是一位公认的牲畜管理与安全临床专家，Gill是德州农工推广专家，他们将提供低应激牛只处理、设施设计和牛肉质量保证协议方面的实践指导。

“Husker Harvest Days自称是世界上最大的全灌溉耕作农场展，”展会宣传材料中强调，该展会在服务西部玉米带作物和畜牧生产者方面具有独特地位。

展会继续为行栽作物农民提供涵盖十多个类别的现场田间演示。2026年新增玉米秸秆打捆、粉碎机和饲料搅拌机演示，以及为精准农业爱好者扩展的无人机区。

近600家参展商将在格兰德岛附近的耕作农场现场布展，吸引来自20多个州的生产者。展会真实的条件——设备在实际田间环境中运行，而非停车场——使其自1978年由《内布拉斯加农民》杂志创办以来成为必参加的活动。

无论您养牛、种庄稼还是两者兼营，展会都提供了关于农业未来走向的实用见解。详情请访问huskerharvestdays.com。
